title: Bacha Coffee taps into PH’s coffee culture with 2 new stores in Manila
summary: MAKATI CITY — Popular high-end luxury coffee brand Bacha Coffee had just landed in Manila, opening stores in Mall of Asia in Pasay City and in Greenbelt 3 in Makati City this month.
